description: Where a holder can borrow against a token: every lending market that takes it as collateral (Euler vaults, Morpho markets, Aave, Spark, Venus and other pooled lenders), with the LTV (the most you can borrow, in % of the collateral), the liquidation LTV, the borrow APY and what the market can lend now. Give amount_usd, the USD value of the tokens to post, to see what that position could borrow in each market and split across markets, so a position larger than the markets can absorb is answered honestly. Ranked by what can be borrowed, then the rate. Updated hourly; market data, not a quote. Free data from AlphaGrowth (alphagrowth.io).

amount_usd.description: The USD value of the tokens to post, to size what they could borrow.

borrow.description: What to borrow: stablecoins, or a token symbol (DAI, WETH). Leave out for anything.

chain.description: Only markets on this chain: its slug or name (base, Ethereum, unichain).

token.description: The token to post as collateral: a symbol (ONDO), a name (Ondo Finance), a project slug or a contract address.

name: borrow_markets
title: Where to borrow against a token
